newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-MIM cuts 31 in transport restructure.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-MIM cuts 31 in transport restructure.

text.p: MIM Holdings Ltd said on Monday that it would make 31 positions redundant because of a restructure of its Isa metals transport operations.
The mining house would also review the operations by February 1997 to ensure it remained competitive, MIM said.

"As a result of these structural changes, 31 positions within Isa Transport Operations will be made redundant," MIM Metals Transport Operations Group Managing Director Kerry Noyes said in a statement announcing the restructure.
Noyes said that to remain a competitive service provider, Isa Transport Operations had to critically examine its current operations.
"The review process will continue and is expected to be completed by February 1997," he said.
